issues.description: Public Farm method name mismatch for printing/singing the song: the problem statement/UML requires a public method named printFarmSong(), but both template and solution provide the public entry point as singFarmSong(). Students following the statement may implement printFarmSong() while the provided skeleton (and likely tests) expect singFarmSong(), or vice versa.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one public API name and use it consistently: either rename Farm.singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() in template+solution (and any call sites), or update the problem statement/UML to require singFarmSong() instead of printFarmSong().

issues.description: Template Farm helper method signature is inconsistent with the specification/solution: the problem statement/UML and solution define a private helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal), but the template comments out the parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), so students cannot call it with an Animal as intended without first changing the signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template signature to match the intended API: private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) { ... } (students will still fill in the body as needed).
